svg.title: Ripplefin Pools — Woven nursery pens and shallow rescue pools
svg.desc: Three nursery pools feed one sheltered channel. Caretaker baskets, low stepping shells and a plank nursery roof form an approachable escort route above the water.
svg.text: Woven nursery pens and shallow rescue pools
Shared access · None hostile; aid creature 1–5
Three nursery pools feed one sheltered channel. Caretaker baskets, low stepping shells and a plank nursery
roof form an approachable escort route above the water.
Shell · kelp rope · sea glass · driftwood · verdigris bronze
Ripplefin Sprout · Benevolent / Common; aid / escort / protection, never a kill-farm target.
